acceptanceCriteria: A test injects an uncoded filesystem error and an uncoded receipt refusal into finish and observes the emitted code
Either both paths carry typed non-MALFORMED codes per ATR-V0-051, or the spec records why MALFORMED is correct there
body: Suspected, not runtime-confirmed (V1-1582 lane review, 2026-10-20, origin/main 2b0cfce94). ATR-V0-051 says a started run never reports MALFORMED for a store write, but internal/tasks/cli/attempt_run.go `finish` can exit 127 with code MALFORMED via wire.CodeOf on (a) an uncoded non-context error such as a filesystem error at attempt_run.go:592, and (b) an outcome receipt refused without a code via `refusal` at attempt_run.go:567. Choosing the right code (e.g. a typed store-write or outcome-not-recorded code) is a design decision. Expected: every post-launch outcome-recording failure carries a typed non-MALFORMED code with 127.
